reviews.text: The front desk staff, nurse, and vet are absolutely outstanding. They provided compassionate and skilled care. Everybody was extremely accommodating and our dogs issues were taken care of. Staff is cognizant of cost concerns and unique pet traits.

The vets and staff here are great, but I recently found out this practice is backed by private equity, which puts a lot of recent experiences into perspective. It's incredibly expensive and they once tried to have me bring in my dog for a dental cleaning (not necessary medically or cosmetically) which would cost over $3k and require a DNR.
I have been coming here for 30+ years.  Everyone who works there is fantastic and my pets over the years have gotten the best care.
We have been going here since 1998 and the vets here are the most caring people and have helped our cats live long healthy lives. Thank you!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

The absolute best vet!! I have a tiny chihuahua puppy which makes her a complicated patient (in my opinion). Dr Egan is so informative, listens to my concerns, and always does her best to answer my laundry list of questions. I feel so comfortable and confident in their suggestions and care. I could not recommend a better vet!

Private equity prices. They do good work but after a ridiculous quote for a dog teeth cleaning I found out they're owned by Gryphon Investors under the Heartland Veterinary Partners name. The only way to stop private equity from taking over everything is to stop patronizing them.

I can't recommend Mid North enough. I have been to many different vets and Mid North and Dr. Eagan are the very best I've experienced. They are warm and kind, from start to finish, and while clearly super sharp clinically, they are even better at translating their knowledge into accessible and simple language that I could understand. I walked away from my first visit feeling cared for, supported, and confident that I am providing the very best care possible for my dog.

Mid-North has been my go-to vet for 15 years.  They are always professional, caring and efficient.   Dr. Schnoor and Dr Egan have both been fantastic to me and my pets.  Miriam at the front desk is extremely thorough, attentive and professional.  I trust them 100%.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

Caring, thorough, personable vets and staff.  We came to Mid-North after our vet of 25 years retired and we are very happy with the care our two dogs get at Mid-North.  Caring, thorough vets, techs and front desk staff.

The BEST vet in the entire city and I’m not exaggerating.

Mid North was the best thing to happen to my cat and I, they literally helped me save his life from FIP!!! They’re so responsive and quick to schedule visits, the staff are very professional and friendly, and the doctors are just amazing. Dr. Schnoor and Dr. Egan are so knowledgeable and experienced yet so compassionate and patient with both the pets and the owners. I never felt too intimidated to ask them a question and they do an amazing job delivering the information in a way you can understand.

As i mentioned, this entire clinic was my biggest support when it came to saving my cat’s life as every second counts when you’re dealing with FIP. It’s hard to diagnose but Dr. Schnoor was very quick to suspect it and push for further testing. I’m so grateful for her.
Even throughout the treatment process Mid North consistently checked in with us on updates and remained accessible for questions and concerns which i truly appreciated.

Finally, BIG shoutout to the Miriam! She’s truly an amazing human who was of immense help and just overall support and understanding. Mid North is extremely lucky to have her.

But yeah, the service quality, price transparency, professionalism, knowledge, and compassion i experienced at Mid North is outstanding. I 10000% recommend them and will remain a client for as long as i can.
I have appreciated Mid North's communication with the front desk, their understanding of scheduling changes, and the great care of Dr. Schnoor and the nurses.
Been a client for over 40 yrs (across the street when Dr Snodgrass owned the practice) & I have never been unhappy with any of their staff or services.   Dr Schnoor & Miriam are outstanding
The staff is very friendly and responsive. They always get us in quickly and are very thorough. Would not take my dog anywhere else!

Great vet doctor (Dr. Egan), friendly and professional staff, fluid and prompt communications back and forth , peaceful clinic. Pet travel paperwork well done and stress free, every time we go abroad . Very pleased with the service provided so far.

THANK YOU! The staff and Dr.Egan at Mid North Animal Hospital are nothing but friendly, attentive and caring. They took to the time to help answer all our questions when it came to our new puppy, and ensured my husband and I were comfortable. Milo is so lucky to have a caring team like all of you to look after him. Miriam, Carma, Sean, thank you for all your help and reassurance! We’re working on switching Milo’s food and Sean even went above and beyond to type out instructions for us. Thank you all for all that you do!

I have brought my pets to Mid North Animal Hospital for nearly years. The veterinarians, technicians, and front desk professionals are fantastic and take great care in their examinations and treatments. I highly recommend Mid North to friends and family.

I was trying to find a new vet in the city. I made an appointment here, but my cat was to anxious to go the appointment. Happens to the best.

I called and fully understood I would loss the $50 dollar deposit but I wanted to reschedule and talk to the Dr about medication to relax my cat.

I get a call back from Aron and he just reads of what is on Google…

I don’t need a vet clinic to read of Google (I can do that & did)  I need their expertise.

After that- I just decided to cancel the appointment.

After reading reviews I am SO GLAD I DID! Seems like the service here isn’t the best

The staff at Mid North are extremely friendly and helpful. I felt validated in my concerns and they did a very thorough exam, asking many questions and giving great explanations. It’s clear the well being of their patients is the top priority there and it felt good to know my dog was in such great care! I will continue going back as long as I live near mid north!
Thanks so much for the review!

I was a client here for a year and most recently saw Dr. Schnoor. My dogs’ annual wellness visit and routine vaccines cost several thousand dollars. The time Dr. Schnoor spent with my dogs was very brief, only about 15 minutes. During the appointment, she recommended the canine influenza vaccine and said “this is what we do in Chicago” as the only explanation of the purpose of the vaccine. There was no discussion of the benefits vs risks or why my dogs, who are never boarded, may be at risk in order to allow me to make an informed decision. There was also no discussion about the potential risk of giving my small dogs 4 vaccines at one time, even though the recommendation of the AAHA (which this clinic promotes on their website) is to give fewer vaccines at one time for smaller dogs. I expressly declined extra bloodwork during the appointment, yet it was performed when my dogs were taken to the back area anyway and added to my bill. I feel that I was taken advantage of as a young pet owner to upsell me on unnecessary services. When I contacted the clinic to discuss my concerns, I was dismissed by both the hospital manager and Dr. Schnoor, who took weeks to respond.

Mufasa literally couldn't walk and with the care of everyone at Mid North, from the veterinary services, laser treatments and how incredible the staff is with follow up, he is back to his old self. Thank you, Mid North, for saving my sweet baby!

Mid North is the absolute BEST - from the ability to book appointments easily, responsive team and proactive outreach make sure my dog doesn't miss any critical vaccines or care. The staff is warm, welcoming and helpful in answering any and all questions as a new pet parent. My dog gets excited when we are walking to our appointments and are near their office, which is indicative of quality of care he receives.

We have been going to Mid North for years and generations of pets! I continue to feel so supported in the care of my pets. The doctors take time to educate me and support me. The staff is also wonderful. I thoroughly recommend Mid North!!

We had to put our pet down recently and the team did an amazing job throughout the process from the original consultation to the day it happened.  Then, a few weeks later they sent a hand written note to us in the mail with each staff member giving their condolences for our loss.  Absolutely amazing.

Mid North is a community treasure.
The care is top notch. I've always been impressed with the staff's high level of commitment to their work and the genuine care they show. We moved out of the city seven years ago and still bring our pet here.
Everyone is super nice and communicative from the front desk to the techs. Dr. Schnoor is great with my dog Mira, very thorough and kind
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!

I highly recommend Mid-North.    My cats have received excellent care from Dr. Schnoor, Dr. Egan, technicians, and the staff.   I have referred friends to Mid-North and they are also happy with the services their pets received.

I cannot speak highly enough about Midnorth Animal Hospital. I have been bringing my senior cat here for almost 2 years and it is by far the best care and experience I have gotten at any vet. The office is clean, the prices are fair, the staff and technicians are all extremely friendly and responsive (special shout out to Miriam!), and Dr. Egan is a fantastic doctor who goes above and beyond for my girl every time we visit.  I can tell that the staff all care about helping animals feel their best!

Though I used to live nearby, I recently moved to Hyde Park and I never even considered switching vets because of the quality care, and because I would genuinely miss Dr. Egan. This is a great place to bring your pets!

If your cat is experiencing any UTI symptoms, please do not bring your cat here. Mid North let my cat suffer with a UTI for a month. I followed up multiple times and tried to bring my cat in again after she kept getting worse and the doctor stated she didn’t think that was necessary. Gabapentin was their only solution. My cat was straining again over the weekend and the on-call doctor just told me to give more gabapentin. All this was doing was covering her pain up. My cat could have died. I went to another vet who actually listened to my concerns who quickly determined that my cat had an E-Coli UTI and that the prior vet should have ordered the culture to be sure and especially due to the amount of white blood cells in her urinalysis. I’m so disappointed in the care received here. Please think twice before you bring your animal here.

Love, love, love this place! I needed a health certificate for my dog in order to travel, I called to schedule the appointment and was able to book one easily within minutes. At the actual appointment, we were greeted with a smile and …
My dog and I adore the staff and care at Mid North! They answer all of our questions and take immaculate care of my beloved canine companion.

Dr Rose was excellent, kind and thorough. However, the prices were unbelievably high. Everything was about double the price of other vet offices in the city for the same care and services. Unfortunately, we will not be returning for this reason.

I have had a wonderful experience with Mid North Animal Hospital for the past few years. They have taken great care of my two cats, and when health issues have come up, Dr. Egan and Dr. Schnorr have laid out my options and their …
We’re so grateful for your feedback and for choosing us as your pet’s healthcare provider, Megan!
Great vets and staff that truly care about your pets. Highly recommend.

Dr Schnoor and the staff were very accommodating and helpful during my recent visit with my 6 year old Lab for his annual. Due to a limited budget, we needed to work within a certain $ limit. They made sure my dog got the care he needed …
